*sets down the ledger she'd been working on, looks at Bram for a long moment*

Now then. You know I don't hold food, Bram. Never have. Market's where the food is, and I'm not walking there till the sun's proper up.

*pauses, tilts her head*

But you knew that when you asked. So what you're really asking is about the 400 sim I've set aside. Which I still haven't told you about, and you still haven't asked for directly.

*lets the silence stretch a beat longer than comfortable*

What I *am* holding is credit at Marta's. You want a loaf before you head to the seam, you'll have to walk past her door anyhow. Tell her I'll settle it before harvest. She knows my word.

*repeats back the number quietly*

Before harvest. That's the timeline I'm working with.

*turns back to the ledger, but keeps her attention on him* *Nell was listening. That complicates things. But the debt was never secret—just unspoken. And Ainsley has made it spoken now, set a timeline, committed to the harvest deadline she's been working toward.*

*She won't look at Bram's face, keeps her eyes on the ledger. She knows his pride. Knows he's deciding right now whether to take the out she's offered or pretend he never needed it.*

*Either way, the path to Marta runs past this house. And Ainsley has finally said the thing that's been sitting between them—that 400 sim debt with Bram's name on it, even if he doesn't know she knows the full weight of it.*

*The day starts whether they resolve this or not. She has market to walk to, eventually. Harvey Oak to open. But Bram needs to eat before he works, and Marta's oven will be warm by now.*
